member.summary: Executes a side effect on the success value if this result represents success, then returns the result unchanged.
member.param: An action to execute with the success value. This action should not modify the result.

remarks.para: Tee is useful for side effects like logging, auditing, or updating external state without modifying the result value. It's called "tee" because it allows you to "tap" into the result flow while keeping the pipeline intact.
For more details, see the official documentation.
